O.outcome_detail: composite care quality across nine RAR indicators

cells.quote: Composite care quality showed non-significant improvement (40.6% vs. 44.4%; OR 1.17, 95% CI 0.44–3.15; p = 0.802).
cells.note: Before-and-after comparison; patients admitted before the workshop formed the pre-intervention cohort and those admitted after formed the post-intervention cohort.

cells.quote: After training, follow-up creatinine monitoring increased modestly to 33.3%.
cells.note: The study reports an increase after training but does not report a significance test for this indicator in the supplied text.
The post-intervention cohort had 18 cases versus 138 pre-intervention cases, and baseline characteristics differed.

O.outcome_detail: in-hospital mortality among pediatric AKI cases

cells.quote: Significant independent predictors of mortality included hypovolemic shock (OR 8.73, 95% CI 2.13–35.76, p = 0.008), severe dehydration (OR 5.29, 95% CI 1.57–17.86, p = 0.009), and hypernatremia (OR 4.18, 95% CI 1.02–17.06, p = 0.045)
cells.note: This is an observational association, not an instructional intervention; the study also reports hospital-stratified analysis for severe dehydration.
